title: Research method for pancreatic cell type-specific T2D effector gene predictions
bodyHtml:
These results were generated in the following study:

3D chromatin maps of the human pancreas reveal lineage-specific regulatory architecture of T2D risk.
Chun Su, Long Gao, Catherine L. May, James A. Pippin, Keith Boehm, Michelle Lee, Chengyang Liu, Matthew C. Pahl, Maria L. Golson, Ali Naji, the HPAP Consortium, Struan F.A. Grant, Andrew D. Wells, Klaus H. Kaestner
Cell Metabolism 34(9), 1394-1409.E4, 2022. doi: 10.1016/j.cmet.2022.08.014

The data sources for this integrative analysis were:

  • High-resolution Hi-C on FACS-sorted pancreatic acinar, alpha, and beta cells from multiple organ donors without diabetes
  • Single-cell ATAC-seq on whole pancreatic islets from three matched donors
  • Single-cell RNA-seq on whole pancreatic islets from three matched donors
  • 403 variants associated with T2D at genome-wide significance (p < 5e-8) or better from the Mahajan et al., 2018 study, and proxy variants in close linkage disequilibrium (r2 > 0.8)

Variants were mapped to genes if 1) they contacted the gene promoter through cell type-specific Hi-C loops or 2) they resided at gene promoters (-1,500bp to +500bp around transcription start site) in the corresponding cell type. The table, based on Supplementary Table 12 of the manuscript, indicates the cell type specificity of the predicted effector genes.
